changelog.summary: Fail-closed CMS identity isolation and explicit Generic CMS package delivery for the local beta candidate.

desktop.changelog: Project each imported post's already verified QDN IMAGE into the CMS index so Home and Posts cards render the WordPress featured image or first suitable body image without an external-media fallback.

publisher.changelog: Validate CMS delivery metadata and the embedded qms-cms-config.json binding to the packaged APP/WEBSITE triple and catalog manifest; visibly distinguish Content only from Generic CMS delivery.

cms.changelog: Fail closed with an explicit diagnostic when a hosted project configuration is missing, invalid or belongs to another APP/WEBSITE identity; never request generic manifest defaults.
